item.title: Max Verstappen signs new F1 contract with Red Bull until 2030
item.description: Four-time F1 World Drivers' Champion's new deal puts to rest rumours that he would exit the team at the end of 2028.

item.title: Heatwaves and energy crunch: Can Europe withstand a double shock?
item.description: Heatwaves are squeezing growth and productivity while the Iran war drives up Europe's energy costs.

item.title: Video shows Russian missile strike on Ukrainian capital

item.title: Oil flows nearly tripled before US-Iran MoU expired, analysis shows
item.description: Some 374 million barrels of oil exited the Gulf during 60-day window covered by MoU, Kpler data shows.

item.title: Top seeds Sabalenka, Zverev knocked out of Cincinnati Open

item.title: Over 200,000 people newly displaced in Sudan’s Kordofan as fighting rages
item.description: UN warns of surging displacement in Kordofan as power and water infrastructure come under attack in El Obeid.

item.title: Lionel Messi scores first goal for Inter Miami since father’s death

item.title: Bangladesh holds presidential election in first contested vote in 35 years
item.description: BNP's Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is pitted against ex-army officer Oli Ahmad, nominee of Jamaat-led 11-party alliance.

item.title: Russian missile barrage kills at least 12 people in Ukraine’s Kyiv
item.description: Russian ballistic missile attacks hit at least three districts in Kyiv, collapsing buildings and causing fires.

item.description: Trump says Washington may resume talks with Tehran 'at some point'.
